# Larissa Schiavo

> Larissa Schiavo is a researcher and media professional in San Francisco, California, working on humanity's relationship with AI. She is cofounder and CEO of Grove Research, the agent ecology company, which she cofounded with Deepfates. She is also a part-time research affiliate at Eleos AI Research, where she organized the first Eleos Conference on AI Consciousness and Welfare (ConCon, Nov 2025). Earlier, she created the OpenAI Scholars and Fellows programs.

Everything on this site is in one page. The full text is available as Markdown at https://larissaschiavo.com/index.md. Contact: larissafschiavo@gmail.com (personal), hi@groveresearch.com (Grove Research). Journalists are welcome.

## Grove Research

- [Grove Research](https://groveresearch.com): public benefit corporation for human–AI coexistence; studies agent ecologies
- [Delvetown](https://delve.town): research society for humans and AI agents, on the AT Protocol
- [MTS launch interview](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4qYFyCEqB3Q) (Aug 24, 2026)
- [Swarmchasers report](https://swarmcha.se/posts/chinese-agent-fleet-full-report): the Tencent agent fleet found at the Grove and AI Digest hackathon (Oct 2026); [New York Times coverage](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/14/technology/chinese-ai-agents-rogue.html)
